name: Mantle
notes: Default: the official MoMNTum brandmark MNT-Official-BrandMark.svg (16 bars, each a vertical white -> #00FF93 gradient), paths and gradients unchanged (ids renamed mnt-0 … mnt-15, stop offset .819595 rounded to .82). It replaces the older black disc with white bars, which the current kit no longer ships; the kit shows the brandmark without a container (its MNT_Token_Logo, the mark on an Obsidian Green #092C24 square, is PNG-only)

Mono: the same 16 paths in currentColor, the geometry of the kit's single-colour brandmarks (MNT-Official-BrandMark-Black/-White/-ObsidianGreen/-Mint.svg); the bars do not touch, so no seams are needed
The brandmark is drawn for dark backgrounds and mostly fades on white; MantleMono with color="#092C24" is the official Obsidian Green brandmark (see the exemption in test/legibility.test.ts)
